ko.title: 추수감사절 식탁 비용: 올해 칠면조, 스터핑, 파이 가격은 얼마나 들까

segments.src: With Thanksgiving about five weeks away, the cost of the holiday meal is already a popular topic at kitchen tables and in grocery aisles.
segments.tr: 추수감사절이 약 5주 앞으로 다가오면서, 명절 식사 비용은 이미 식탁과 식료품점 통로에서 뜨거운 주제가 되고 있습니다.

segments.src: Households that host a big dinner often start planning early, and many want to know whether the familiar menu of turkey, stuffing, vegetables and pie will cost more or less than last year.
segments.tr: 대규모 저녁 식사를 대접하는 가구는 일찍부터 계획을 세우기 시작하며, 많은 이들이 칠면조, 스터핑, 채소, 파이로 구성된 친숙한 메뉴가 지난해보다 비용이 더 들지 아니면 적게 들지 궁금해합니다.

segments.src: This guide explains what tends to drive the price of the main ingredients and how to read the annual dinner-cost surveys without over-interpreting a single headline number.
segments.tr: 이 가이드는 주요 재료의 가격을 결정하는 요인이 무엇인지, 그리고 단일 헤드라인 숫자를 과도하게 해석하지 않으면서 연례 저녁 식사 비용 조사 결과를 읽는 방법을 설명합니다.

segments.src: It does not predict exact prices.
segments.tr: 정확한 가격을 예측하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: Costs vary by region, store and week.
segments.tr: 비용은 지역, 매장, 주차별로 다릅니다.

segments.src: ## Why Thanksgiving Prices Get So Much Attention
segments.tr: ## 추수감사절 물가가 이토록 큰 관심을 받는 이유

segments.src: Thanksgiving is one of the few meals in the United States built around a nearly standard menu.
segments.tr: 추수감사절은 미국에서 거의 표준화된 메뉴를 중심으로 차려지는 몇 안 되는 식사 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: That makes it a convenient yardstick.
segments.tr: 따라서 유용한 기준이 됩니다.

segments.src: Because most households buy a similar set of items, changes in the total are easy to compare from one year to the next.
segments.tr: 대부분의 가구가 비슷한 품목을 구매하기 때문에, 총액의 변화를 한해 한해 비교하기가 쉽습니다.

segments.src: The meal also stands in for broader grocery inflation, so a rise or fall in the "dinner bill" often shapes conversations about everyday food costs.
segments.tr: 또한 이 식사는 더 광범위한 식료품 물가 상승률을 대변하므로, "저녁 식사 비용"의 상승이나 하락은 일상적인 식비에 관한 대화 방향을 좌우하곤 합니다.

segments.src: ## Turkey: Supply, Disease and Timing
segments.tr: ## 칠면조: 공급, 질병 및 시기

segments.src: The turkey is usually the most expensive single item, and its price depends on several factors:
segments.tr: 칠면조는 보통 가장 expensive한 단일 품목이며, 가격은 몇 가지 요인에 따라 달라집니다.

segments.src: - **Flock size.** Producers decide months ahead how many birds to raise. Outbreaks of avian influenza can shrink flocks and tighten supply, which has pushed turkey prices up in past years.
segments.tr: - **사육 규모.** 생산자는 수개월 전에 몇 마리의 조류를 키울지 결정합니다. 조류 인플루엔자의 발생은 사육 규모를 줄이고 공급을 조여 지난 몇 년간 칠면조 가격을 올리는 원인이 되었습니다.

segments.src: - **Feed and energy costs.** Grain prices, fuel and processing expenses all feed into the final shelf price.
segments.tr: - **사료 및 에너지 비용.** 곡물 가격, 연료 및 가공비는 모두 최종 판매 가격에 반영됩니다.

segments.src: - **Retail strategy.** Many grocery chains treat turkey as a "loss leader." They discount it heavily, sometimes in exchange for a minimum purchase, to bring shoppers into the store.
segments.tr: - **소매 전략.** 많은 식료품 체인이 칠면조를 "미끼 상품(loss leader)"으로 취급합니다. 이들은 고객을 매장으로 유인하기 위해 때로는 최소 구매 금액을 조건으로 대폭 할인합니다.

segments.src: - **Timing.** Frozen turkeys are often cheapest in the weeks right before the holiday, while fresh birds usually cost more per pound.
segments.tr: - **시기.** 냉동 칠면조는 명절 직전 몇 주 동안 가장 저렴한 경우가 많으며, 생육 칠면조는 보통 파운드당 가격이 더 비쌉니다.

segments.src: ## Dairy: Butter, Cream and Milk
segments.tr: ## 유제품: 버터, 크림, 우유

segments.src: Dairy shows up in mashed potatoes, casseroles, rolls and pie fillings.
segments.tr: 유제품은 매시드 포테이토, 캐서롤, 롤빵, 파이 속재료 등에 사용됩니다.

segments.src: Prices follow milk supply, feed costs, seasonal demand and trade conditions.
segments.tr: 가격은 원유 공급, 사료비, 계절적 수요, 무역 조건에 따라 변동합니다.

segments.src: Butter and cream tend to be more volatile than milk, and demand rises sharply in the weeks around the holidays.
segments.tr: 버터와 크림은 우유보다 변동성이 큰 편이며, 연휴 전후 몇 주 동안 수요가 급증합니다.

segments.src: Store brands are often noticeably cheaper than name brands for the same ingredient.
segments.tr: 동일한 재료에 대해 매장 자체 브랜드(PB)가 유명 브랜드보다 눈에 띄게 저렴한 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: ## Produce: Weather and Transportation
segments.tr: ## 농산물: 날씨 및 운송

segments.src: Fresh vegetables, cranberries, sweet potatoes and potatoes are sensitive to weather, harvest conditions and transportation costs.
segments.tr: 신선한 채소, 크랜베리, 고구마, 감자는 날씨, 수확 여건, 운송비에 민감합니다.

segments.src: A poor growing season in one region can lift prices nationally, while a strong harvest can keep them steady.
segments.tr: 한 지역의 수확량이 저조하면 전국적으로 가격이 오를 수 있는 반면, 풍작이 이루어지면 가격이 안정적으로 유지될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Canned and frozen versions of many items are often cheaper and last longer, which makes them a practical option for the side dishes.
segments.tr: 많은 품목의 통조림 및 냉동 제품은 더 저렴하고 오래 보관할 수 있어 사이드 디시를 위한 실용적인 선택이 됩니다.

segments.src: ## Stuffing, Rolls and Pie
segments.tr: ## 스터핑, 롤빵 및 파이

segments.src: Packaged stuffing mix, bread, flour, sugar and pie crusts depend largely on wheat, sugar and packaging costs.
segments.tr: 포장된 스터핑 믹스, 빵, 밀가루, 설탕, 파이 크러스트의 가격은 주로 밀, 설탕, 포장비에 좌우됩니다.

segments.src: Pumpkin and pecan pie ingredients can swing with crop conditions.
segments.tr: 호박파이와 호두파이 재료는 작황 상태에 따라 가격이 요동칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Many shoppers save money by baking from scratch, while others find a store-bought pie cheaper once their time and extra ingredients are counted.
segments.tr: 많은 구매자가 직접 재료를 사서 구움으로써 돈을 절약하는 반면, 어떤 이들은 자신의 시간과 추가 재료를 고려했을 때 시판 파이를 사는 것이 더 저렴하다고 느낍니다.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Annual Dinner-Cost Surveys
segments.tr: ## 연례 저녁 식사 비용 조사를 읽는 법

segments.src: Several organizations publish a yearly estimate of the cost of a Thanksgiving dinner.
segments.tr: 여러 기관에서 추수감사절 저녁 식사 비용에 대한 연간 추정치를 발표합니다.

segments.src: The best known is the American Farm Bureau Federation's survey, which prices a classic menu for a set number of guests, typically ten, using reports from volunteer shoppers across the country.
segments.tr: 가장 잘 알려진 것은 미국 농업인연합회(American Farm Bureau Federation)의 조사로, 전국 자원봉사 쇼핑객의 보고를 바탕으로 정해진 인원(보통 10명)을 위한 클래식 메뉴의 가격을 산정합니다.

segments.src: Some retailers and consumer groups publish their own versions.
segments.tr: 일부 소매업체와 소비자 단체도 자체 버전을 발표합니다.

segments.src: A few points help put these numbers in context:
segments.tr: 이러한 수치를 맥락에 맞게 이해하는 데 도움이 되는 몇 가지 사항은 다음과 같습니다.

segments.src: 1. **Check the menu.** Surveys price a specific list of items. If your table has more dishes, different dishes or a larger crowd, your total will differ.
segments.tr: 1. **메뉴 확인하기.** 조사는 특정 품목 목록의 가격을 매깁니다. 식탁에 더 많은 요리, 다른 요리가 오르거나 인원이 더 많다면 총액은 달라집니다.

segments.src: 2. **Look at the method.** Some surveys use regular shelf prices, while others include promotions. Results can differ by several dollars for that reason alone.
segments.tr: 2. **방식 살펴보기.** 일부 조사는 일반 판매 가격을 사용하는 반면, 다른 조사는 프로모션 할인을 포함합니다. 이 이유만으로도 결과가 수 달러씩 차이 날 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Compare like with like.** A survey from one organization is not directly comparable to a survey from another.
segments.tr: 3. **동일 선상에서 비교하기.** 한 기관의 조사 결과를 다른 기관의 조사 결과와 직접 비교할 수는 없습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Remember it's an average.** Prices in a big city, a rural town and a discount grocer can differ widely.
segments.tr: 4. **평균치임을 기억하기.** 대도시, 시골 마을, 할인 식료품점의 가격은 크게 다를 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 5. **Watch the trend, not the decimal.** A small change from last year may not mean much. A larger shift, and what caused it, is more informative.
segments.tr: 5. **소수점이 아닌 트렌드에 주목하기.** 지난해에 비해 약간의 변화가 있는 것은 큰 의미가 없을 수 있습니다. 더 큰 변화와 그 원인이 무엇인지가 더 유용한 정보를 제공합니다.

segments.src: 6. **Note the timing.** Prices are collected weeks before the holiday, and store sales may change what you actually pay.
segments.tr: 6. **시기 유의하기.** 가격은 명절 몇 주 전에 수집되므로, 매장 세일에 따라 실제 지불하는 금액이 달라질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Keep the Bill in Check
segments.tr: ## 지출을 줄이기 위한 실용적인 방법

segments.src: - **Make a menu and a list first.** Planning cuts impulse purchases and food waste.
segments.tr: - **메뉴와 목록부터 작성하기.** 계획을 세우면 충동구매와 음식물 쓰레기를 줄일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Compare unit prices.** The price per pound or per ounce shows the real value better than the sticker price.
segments.tr: - **단가 비교하기.** 파운드당 또는 온스당 가격은 표시 가격보다 실제 가치를 더 잘 보여줍니다.

segments.src: - **Use store promotions and loyalty programs,** but check whether a turkey deal requires a minimum spend.
segments.tr: - **매장 프로모션과 적립 프로그램을 활용하기.** 단, 칠면조 할인 행사에 최소 구매 금액 조건이 있는지 확인하세요.

segments.src: - **Consider alternatives.** A smaller bird, a turkey breast or a different main dish can lower costs for a smaller group.
segments.tr: - **대안 고려하기.** 더 작은 칠면조, 칠면조 가슴살 또는 다른 메인 요리를 선택하면 적은 인원의 비용을 줄일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Buy shelf-stable items early** and watch for sales on baking staples.
segments.tr: - **장기 보관이 가능한 품목은 일찍 구입하기** 그리고 제과·제빵 기본 재료의 세일을 주시하세요.

segments.src: - **Share the load.** Asking guests to bring a side dish or dessert spreads out the expense.
segments.tr: - **부담 나누기.** 손님들에게 사이드 디시나 디저트를 가져오도록 부탁하면 비용이 분산됩니다.

segments.src: - **Plan for leftovers** so less food goes to waste.
segments.tr: - **남은 음식 활용 계획 세우기** 버려지는 음식을 줄이세요.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: Nobody can say exactly what your Thanksgiving table will cost until you are at the checkout.
segments.tr: 계산대에 서기 전까지는 누구도 당신의 추수감사절 식탁 비용이 정확히 얼마나 들지 알 수 없습니다.

segments.src: Still, understanding what moves the price of turkey, dairy and produce, and knowing how the annual surveys are built, can help you separate real trends from headlines.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 칠면조, 유제품, 농산물 가격을 움직이는 요인을 이해하고 연례 조사 방식의 구성을 파악하면 자극적인 헤드라인 속에서 실제 트렌드를 구분하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: A little planning and some comparison shopping will usually do more for your budget than any national average.
segments.tr: 작은 계획과 비교 쇼핑은 보통 그 어떤 전국 평균치보다 당신의 예산에 더 큰 도움이 될 것입니다.

segments.tr: *본 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 하며 재무적 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## Why Thanksgiving Prices Get So Much Attention

segments.tr: 感恩节是美国少数几个围绕近乎标准菜单构建的节日餐食之一。

segments.src: ## Turkey: Supply, Disease and Timing
segments.tr: ## 火鸡：供应、疾病与时机

segments.src: The turkey is usually the most expensive single item, and its price depends on several factors:
segments.tr: 火鸡通常是最昂贵的单项商品，其价格取决于几个因素：

segments.src: - **Flock size.** Producers decide months ahead how many birds to raise. Outbreaks of avian influenza can shrink flocks and tighten supply, which has pushed turkey prices up in past years.
segments.tr: - **种群规模。** 生产商提前数月决定养殖多少羽家禽。禽流感的爆发可能会缩减禽群并紧缩供应，这在过去几年曾推高火鸡价格。

segments.src: - **Feed and energy costs.** Grain prices, fuel and processing expenses all feed into the final shelf price.
segments.tr: - **饲料和能源成本。** 粮食价格、燃料和加工费用都会反映在最终的上架价格中。

segments.src: - **Retail strategy.** Many grocery chains treat turkey as a "loss leader." They discount it heavily, sometimes in exchange for a minimum purchase, to bring shoppers into the store.
segments.tr: - **零售策略。** 许多超市连锁店将火鸡视为“引流亏本商品”（loss leader）。他们会大幅打折，有时以最低消费额为条件，以吸引顾客光顾商店。

segments.src: - **Timing.** Frozen turkeys are often cheapest in the weeks right before the holiday, while fresh birds usually cost more per pound.
segments.tr: - **购买时机。** 冻火鸡通常在节日前的几周内最便宜，而新鲜火鸡按磅计算通常更贵。

segments.src: ## Dairy: Butter, Cream and Milk
segments.tr: ## 乳制品：黄油、奶油和牛奶

segments.src: Dairy shows up in mashed potatoes, casseroles, rolls and pie fillings.
segments.tr: 乳制品广泛应用于土豆泥、砂锅菜、小面包和派馅中。

segments.src: Prices follow milk supply, feed costs, seasonal demand and trade conditions.
segments.tr: 价格取决于牛奶供应、饲料成本、季节性需求和贸易状况。

segments.src: Butter and cream tend to be more volatile than milk, and demand rises sharply in the weeks around the holidays.
segments.tr: 黄油和奶油往往比牛奶的价格波动更大，并且需求在节日临近的前后几周内剧增。

segments.src: Store brands are often noticeably cheaper than name brands for the same ingredient.
segments.tr: 对于相同的食材，自有品牌通常明显比知名品牌更便宜。

segments.src: ## Produce: Weather and Transportation
segments.tr: ## 农产品：天气与运输

segments.src: Fresh vegetables, cranberries, sweet potatoes and potatoes are sensitive to weather, harvest conditions and transportation costs.
segments.tr: 新鲜蔬菜、蔓越莓、红薯和土豆对天气、收成状况和运输成本非常敏感。

segments.src: A poor growing season in one region can lift prices nationally, while a strong harvest can keep them steady.
segments.tr: 一个地区的糟糕生长季可能会推高全国范围内的价格，而丰收则能维持价格稳定。

segments.src: Canned and frozen versions of many items are often cheaper and last longer, which makes them a practical option for the side dishes.
segments.tr: 许多商品的罐装和冻干版本通常更便宜且保质期更长，这使其成为配菜的实用选择。

segments.src: ## Stuffing, Rolls and Pie
segments.tr: ## 填料、小面包和派

segments.src: Packaged stuffing mix, bread, flour, sugar and pie crusts depend largely on wheat, sugar and packaging costs.
segments.tr: 包装好的填料混合料、面包、面粉、糖和派皮很大程度上取决于小麦、糖和包装成本。

segments.src: Pumpkin and pecan pie ingredients can swing with crop conditions.
segments.tr: 南瓜派和山核桃派的原料会随着作物状况而波动。

segments.src: Many shoppers save money by baking from scratch, while others find a store-bought pie cheaper once their time and extra ingredients are counted.
segments.tr: 许多顾客通过从头自己烘焙来省钱，而另一些人则发现，如果算上时间和额外食材，购买现成的派反而更便宜。

segments.src: ## How to Read the Annual Dinner-Cost Surveys
segments.tr: ## 如何解读每年的晚餐成本调查

segments.src: Several organizations publish a yearly estimate of the cost of a Thanksgiving dinner.
segments.tr: 一些机构每年都会发布一份感恩节晚餐成本的估算。

segments.src: The best known is the American Farm Bureau Federation's survey, which prices a classic menu for a set number of guests, typically ten, using reports from volunteer shoppers across the country.
segments.tr: 最知名的是美国农场局联合会（American Farm Bureau Federation）的调查，该调查利用来自全国各地志愿者顾客的报告，对设定人数（通常为 10 人）的经典菜单进行定价。

segments.src: Some retailers and consumer groups publish their own versions.
segments.tr: 一些零售商和消费者团体也会发布他们自己的版本。

segments.src: A few points help put these numbers in context:
segments.tr: 以下几点有助于将这些数字置于具体语境中理解：

segments.src: 1. **Check the menu.** Surveys price a specific list of items. If your table has more dishes, different dishes or a larger crowd, your total will differ.
segments.tr: 1. **核对菜单。** 调查是对特定商品清单进行定价。如果你的餐桌上有更多菜肴、不同的菜肴或更多的客人，你的总开销就会有所不同。

segments.src: 2. **Look at the method.** Some surveys use regular shelf prices, while others include promotions. Results can differ by several dollars for that reason alone.
segments.tr: 2. **查看方法。** 一些调查使用常规上架价格，而另一些则包含促销优惠。仅凭这一点，结果就可能相差几美元。

segments.src: 3. **Compare like with like.** A survey from one organization is not directly comparable to a survey from another.
segments.tr: 3. **同类对比。** 来自一个机构的调查与来自另一个机构的调查不可直接进行比较。

segments.src: 4. **Remember it's an average.** Prices in a big city, a rural town and a discount grocer can differ widely.
segments.tr: 4. **记住这是一个平均值。** 大城市、乡村小镇和折扣超市的价格可能会大不相同。

segments.src: 5. **Watch the trend, not the decimal.** A small change from last year may not mean much. A larger shift, and what caused it, is more informative.
segments.tr: 5. **看趋势，而不是小数点。** 与去年相比的小幅变化可能并没有多大意义。更大的转变以及导致转变的原因更有参考价值。

segments.src: 6. **Note the timing.** Prices are collected weeks before the holiday, and store sales may change what you actually pay.
segments.tr: 6. **注意时间点。** 价格数据是在节日到来前数周收集的，而门店促销可能会改变你实际支付的金额。

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Keep the Bill in Check
segments.tr: ## 控费的实用方法

segments.src: - **Make a menu and a list first.** Planning cuts impulse purchases and food waste.
segments.tr: - **先列菜单和购物清单。** 提前规划可以减少冲动消费和食物浪费。

segments.src: - **Compare unit prices.** The price per pound or per ounce shows the real value better than the sticker price.
segments.tr: - **比较单价。** 每磅或每盎司的价格比标价更能反映真实价值。

segments.src: - **Use store promotions and loyalty programs,** but check whether a turkey deal requires a minimum spend.
segments.tr: - **利用门店促销和会员计划，** 但要核对火鸡优惠是否要求达到最低消费额。

segments.src: - **Consider alternatives.** A smaller bird, a turkey breast or a different main dish can lower costs for a smaller group.
segments.tr: - **考虑替代方案。** 对于人数较少的聚会，更小的火鸡、火鸡胸肉或不同的主菜可以降低成本。

segments.src: - **Buy shelf-stable items early** and watch for sales on baking staples.
segments.tr: - **提早购买耐贮存商品，** 并密切关注烘焙必需品的打折信息。

segments.src: - **Share the load.** Asking guests to bring a side dish or dessert spreads out the expense.
segments.tr: - **分担费用。** 让客人自带一道配菜或甜点可以分散开支。

segments.src: - **Plan for leftovers** so less food goes to waste.
segments.tr: - **计划处理剩菜，** 从而减少食物浪费。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: Nobody can say exactly what your Thanksgiving table will cost until you are at the checkout.
segments.tr: 在你结账之前，没有人能准确说出你的感恩节餐桌要花多少钱。

segments.src: Still, understanding what moves the price of turkey, dairy and produce, and knowing how the annual surveys are built, can help you separate real trends from headlines.
segments.tr: 尽管如此，了解影响火鸡、乳制品和农产品价格波动的因素，并了解年度调查是如何制作的，有助于你从新闻标题中分辨出真正的趋势。

segments.src: A little planning and some comparison shopping will usually do more for your budget than any national average.
segments.tr: 相比任何全国平均水准，一点点规划和一些比价购物通常能为你的预算带来更多实惠。

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not financial advice.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般信息参考，不构成财务建议。

segments.src: Prices vary by location and retailer.*
segments.tr: 价格因地点和零售商而异。*

hi.title: थैंक्सगिविंग टेबल बिल: इस साल टर्की, स्टफिंग और पाई पर कितना खर्च हो सकता है

segments.src: With Thanksgiving about five weeks away, the cost of the holiday meal is already a popular topic at kitchen tables and in grocery aisles.
segments.tr: थैंक्सगिविंग में लगभग पांच सप्ताह बचे हैं, ऐसे में छुट्टी के भोजन की लागत रसोई की मेजों और किराने की दुकानों में पहले से ही एक लोकप्रिय विषय है।

segments.src: Households that host a big dinner often start planning early, and many want to know whether the familiar menu of turkey, stuffing, vegetables and pie will cost more or less than last year.
segments.tr: जो परिवार बड़ा रात्रिभोज आयोजित करते हैं, वे अक्सर जल्दी योजना बनाना शुरू कर देते हैं, और कई लोग यह जानना चाहते हैं कि क्या टर्की, स्टफिंग, सब्जियों और पाई का परिचित मेनू पिछले साल की तुलना में अधिक महंगा होगा या सस्ता।

segments.src: This guide explains what tends to drive the price of the main ingredients and how to read the annual dinner-cost surveys without over-interpreting a single headline number.
segments.tr: यह गाइड बताती है कि मुख्य सामग्रियों की कीमत को क्या प्रभावित करता है और किसी एक हेडलाइन नंबर को बहुत अधिक महत्व दिए बिना वार्षिक रात्रिभोज-लागत सर्वेक्षणों को कैसे पढ़ा जाए।

segments.src: It does not predict exact prices.
segments.tr: यह सटीक कीमतों की भविष्यवाणी नहीं करती है।

segments.src: Costs vary by region, store and week.
segments.tr: लागत क्षेत्र, स्टोर और सप्ताह के अनुसार भिन्न होती है।

segments.src: ## Why Thanksgiving Prices Get So Much Attention
segments.tr: ## थैंक्सगिविंग की कीमतों पर इतना ध्यान क्यों दिया जाता है

segments.src: Thanksgiving is one of the few meals in the United States built around a nearly standard menu.
segments.tr: थैंक्सगिविंग संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में उन कुछ भोजनों में से एक है जो लगभग एक मानक मेनू के इर्द-गिर्द तैयार किए जाते हैं।

segments.src: That makes it a convenient yardstick.
segments.tr: यह इसे एक सुविधाजनक पैमाना बनाता है।

segments.src: Because most households buy a similar set of items, changes in the total are easy to compare from one year to the next.
segments.tr: चूंकि अधिकांश परिवार समान वस्तुओं का सेट खरीदते हैं, इसलिए कुल लागत में बदलाव की तुलना एक साल से दूसरे साल करना आसान होता है।

segments.src: The meal also stands in for broader grocery inflation, so a rise or fall in the "dinner bill" often shapes conversations about everyday food costs.
segments.tr: यह भोजन व्यापक किराना मुद्रास्फीति का भी प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, इसलिए "डिनर बिल" में वृद्धि या गिरावट अक्सर रोजमर्रा के भोजन की लागत के बारे में बातचीत को आकार देती है।

segments.src: ## Turkey: Supply, Disease and Timing
segments.tr: ## टर्की: आपूर्ति, बीमारी और समय

segments.src: The turkey is usually the most expensive single item, and its price depends on several factors:
segments.tr: टर्की आमतौर पर सबसे महंगी एकल वस्तु होती है, और इसकी कीमत कई कारकों पर निर्भर करती है:

segments.src: - **Flock size.** Producers decide months ahead how many birds to raise. Outbreaks of avian influenza can shrink flocks and tighten supply, which has pushed turkey prices up in past years.
segments.tr: - **झुंड का आकार।** उत्पादक महीनों पहले तय करते हैं कि कितने पक्षियों को पालना है। एवियन इन्फ्लूएंजा (बर्ड फ्लू) का प्रकोप झुंड को कम कर सकता है और आपूर्ति को सीमित कर सकता है, जिसने पिछले वर्षों में टर्की की कीमतों को ऊपर धकेला है।

segments.src: - **Feed and energy costs.** Grain prices, fuel and processing expenses all feed into the final shelf price.
segments.tr: - **चारा और ऊर्जा लागत।** अनाज की कीमतें, ईंधन और प्रसंस्करण व्यय सभी अंतिम खुदरा कीमत में जुड़ जाते हैं।

segments.src: - **Retail strategy.** Many grocery chains treat turkey as a "loss leader." They discount it heavily, sometimes in exchange for a minimum purchase, to bring shoppers into the store.
segments.tr: - **खुदरा रणनीति।** कई किराना चेन टर्की को "लॉस लीडर" के रूप में देखती हैं। वे इसे भारी छूट पर बेचती हैं, कभी-कभी न्यूनतम खरीदारी की शर्त पर, ताकि खरीदारों को स्टोर तक लाया जा सके।

segments.src: - **Timing.** Frozen turkeys are often cheapest in the weeks right before the holiday, while fresh birds usually cost more per pound.
segments.tr: - **समय।** फ्रोजन टर्की अक्सर छुट्टी से ठीक पहले के हफ्तों में सबसे सस्ती होती है, जबकि ताजे पक्षियों की कीमत प्रति पाउंड आमतौर पर अधिक होती है।

segments.src: ## Dairy: Butter, Cream and Milk
segments.tr: ## डेयरी: मक्खन, क्रीम और दूध

segments.src: Dairy shows up in mashed potatoes, casseroles, rolls and pie fillings.
segments.tr: डेयरी का उपयोग मैश किए हुए आलू, कैसरोल, रोल और पाई फिलिंग में होता है।

segments.src: Prices follow milk supply, feed costs, seasonal demand and trade conditions.
segments.tr: कीमतें दूध की आपूर्ति, चारे की लागत, मौसमी मांग और व्यापार की स्थितियों का पालन करती हैं।

segments.src: Butter and cream tend to be more volatile than milk, and demand rises sharply in the weeks around the holidays.
segments.tr: मक्खन और क्रीम दूध की तुलना में अधिक अस्थिर होते हैं, और छुट्टियों के आसपास के हफ्तों में मांग तेजी से बढ़ती है।

segments.src: Store brands are often noticeably cheaper than name brands for the same ingredient.
segments.tr: स्टोर ब्रांड अक्सर समान सामग्री के लिए नामी ब्रांडों की तुलना में काफी सस्ते होते हैं।

segments.src: ## Produce: Weather and Transportation
segments.tr: ## उपज: मौसम और परिवहन

segments.src: Fresh vegetables, cranberries, sweet potatoes and potatoes are sensitive to weather, harvest conditions and transportation costs.
segments.tr: ताजी सब्जियां, क्रैनबेरी, शकरकंद और आलू मौसम, फसल की स्थिति और परिवहन लागत के प्रति संवेदनशील होते हैं।

segments.src: A poor growing season in one region can lift prices nationally, while a strong harvest can keep them steady.
segments.tr: एक क्षेत्र में खराब फसल का मौसम राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर कीमतों को बढ़ा सकता है, जबकि अच्छी फसल उन्हें स्थिर रख सकती है।

segments.src: Canned and frozen versions of many items are often cheaper and last longer, which makes them a practical option for the side dishes.
segments.tr: कई वस्तुओं के डिब्बाबंद और फ्रोजन संस्करण अक्सर सस्ते होते हैं और लंबे समय तक चलते हैं, जो उन्हें साइड डिश के लिए एक व्यावहारिक विकल्प बनाता है।

segments.src: ## Stuffing, Rolls and Pie
segments.tr: ## स्टफिंग, रोल और पाई

segments.src: Packaged stuffing mix, bread, flour, sugar and pie crusts depend largely on wheat, sugar and packaging costs.
segments.tr: पैकेज्ड स्टफिंग मिक्स, ब्रेड, आटा, चीनी और पाई क्रस्ट काफी हद तक गेहूं, चीनी और पैकेजिंग लागत पर निर्भर करते हैं।

segments.src: Pumpkin and pecan pie ingredients can swing with crop conditions.
segments.tr: कद्दू और पेकान पाई की सामग्री फसल की स्थितियों के साथ बदल सकती है।

segments.src: Many shoppers save money by baking from scratch, while others find a store-bought pie cheaper once their time and extra ingredients are counted.
segments.tr: कई खरीदार घर पर बनाकर पैसे बचाते हैं, जबकि अन्य को समय और अतिरिक्त सामग्री की गणना करने के बाद स्टोर से खरीदी गई पाई सस्ती लगती है।

segments.src: ## How to Read the Annual Dinner-Cost Surveys
segments.tr: ## वार्षिक रात्रिभोज-लागत सर्वेक्षणों को कैसे पढ़ें

segments.src: Several organizations publish a yearly estimate of the cost of a Thanksgiving dinner.
segments.tr: कई संगठन थैंक्सगिविंग रात्रिभोज की लागत का वार्षिक अनुमान प्रकाशित करते हैं।

segments.src: The best known is the American Farm Bureau Federation's survey, which prices a classic menu for a set number of guests, typically ten, using reports from volunteer shoppers across the country.
segments.tr: सबसे प्रसिद्ध अमेरिकन फार्म ब्यूरो फेडरेशन का सर्वेक्षण है, जो देश भर के स्वयंसेवक खरीदारों की रिपोर्ट का उपयोग करके मेहमानों की एक निर्धारित संख्या, आमतौर पर दस, के लिए एक क्लासिक मेनू की कीमत तय करता है।

segments.src: Some retailers and consumer groups publish their own versions.
segments.tr: कुछ खुदरा विक्रेता और उपभोक्ता समूह अपने स्वयं के संस्करण प्रकाशित करते हैं।

segments.src: A few points help put these numbers in context:
segments.tr: कुछ बिंदु इन संख्याओं को संदर्भ में रखने में मदद करते हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Check the menu.** Surveys price a specific list of items. If your table has more dishes, different dishes or a larger crowd, your total will differ.
segments.tr: 1. **मेनू की जांच करें।** सर्वेक्षण वस्तुओं की एक विशिष्ट सूची की कीमत तय करते हैं। यदि आपकी मेज पर अधिक व्यंजन, अलग व्यंजन या अधिक लोग हैं, तो आपका कुल खर्च अलग होगा।

segments.src: 2. **Look at the method.** Some surveys use regular shelf prices, while others include promotions. Results can differ by several dollars for that reason alone.
segments.tr: 2. **तरीके को देखें।** कुछ सर्वेक्षण नियमित शेल्फ कीमतों का उपयोग करते हैं, जबकि अन्य में प्रचार शामिल होते हैं। केवल इसी कारण से परिणाम कई डॉलर तक भिन्न हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: 3. **Compare like with like.** A survey from one organization is not directly comparable to a survey from another.
segments.tr: 3. **समान की तुलना समान से करें।** एक संगठन का सर्वेक्षण दूसरे संगठन के सर्वेक्षण से सीधे तुलनीय नहीं है।

segments.src: 4. **Remember it's an average.** Prices in a big city, a rural town and a discount grocer can differ widely.
segments.tr: 4. **याद रखें कि यह एक औसत है।** एक बड़े शहर, एक ग्रामीण कस्बे और एक डिस्काउंट ग्रोसरी स्टोर में कीमतें काफी भिन्न हो सकती हैं।

segments.src: 5. **Watch the trend, not the decimal.** A small change from last year may not mean much. A larger shift, and what caused it, is more informative.
segments.tr: 5. **दशमलव नहीं, रुझान देखें।** पिछले साल से एक छोटा सा बदलाव बहुत मायने नहीं रख सकता है। एक बड़ा बदलाव, और उसका कारण क्या था, अधिक जानकारीपूर्ण है।

segments.src: 6. **Note the timing.** Prices are collected weeks before the holiday, and store sales may change what you actually pay.

es.title: La factura de la mesa de Acción de Gracias: cuánto podrían costar el pavo, el relleno y el pastel este año

segments.src: With Thanksgiving about five weeks away, the cost of the holiday meal is already a popular topic at kitchen tables and in grocery aisles.
segments.tr: A falta de unas cinco semanas para Acción de Gracias, el costo de la comida festiva ya es un tema popular en las mesas de cocina y en los pasillos de los supermercados.

segments.src: Households that host a big dinner often start planning early, and many want to know whether the familiar menu of turkey, stuffing, vegetables and pie will cost more or less than last year.
segments.tr: Los hogares que organizan una gran cena a menudo comienzan a planificar con anticipación, y muchos quieren saber si el menú habitual de pavo, relleno, verduras y pastel costará más o menos que el año pasado.

segments.src: This guide explains what tends to drive the price of the main ingredients and how to read the annual dinner-cost surveys without over-interpreting a single headline number.
segments.tr: Esta guía explica qué tiende a influir en el precio de los ingredientes principales y cómo leer las encuestas anuales sobre el costo de la cena sin sobreinterpretar una cifra principal.

segments.src: It does not predict exact prices.
segments.tr: No predice precios exactos.

segments.src: Costs vary by region, store and week.
segments.tr: Los costos varían según la región, la tienda y la semana.

segments.src: ## Why Thanksgiving Prices Get So Much Attention
segments.tr: ## Por qué los precios de Acción de Gracias reciben tanta atención

segments.src: Thanksgiving is one of the few meals in the United States built around a nearly standard menu.
segments.tr: Acción de Gracias es una de las pocas comidas en los Estados Unidos que se basa en un menú casi estándar.

segments.src: That makes it a convenient yardstick.
segments.tr: Eso lo convierte en un punto de referencia conveniente.

segments.src: Because most households buy a similar set of items, changes in the total are easy to compare from one year to the next.
segments.tr: Debido a que la mayoría de los hogares compran un conjunto similar de artículos, los cambios en el total son fáciles de comparar de un año a otro.

segments.src: The meal also stands in for broader grocery inflation, so a rise or fall in the "dinner bill" often shapes conversations about everyday food costs.
segments.tr: La comida también representa la inflación general de los comestibles, por lo que un aumento o una caída en la "factura de la cena" a menudo da forma a las conversaciones sobre los costos diarios de los alimentos.

segments.src: ## Turkey: Supply, Disease and Timing
segments.tr: ## Pavo: suministro, enfermedades y tiempos

segments.src: The turkey is usually the most expensive single item, and its price depends on several factors:
segments.tr: El pavo suele ser el artículo individual más caro, y su precio depende de varios factores:

segments.src: - **Flock size.** Producers decide months ahead how many birds to raise. Outbreaks of avian influenza can shrink flocks and tighten supply, which has pushed turkey prices up in past years.
segments.tr: - **Tamaño de la parvada.** Los productores deciden con meses de antelación cuántas aves criar. Los brotes de gripe aviar pueden reducir las parvadas y restringir la oferta, lo que ha hecho subir los precios del pavo en años anteriores.

segments.src: - **Feed and energy costs.** Grain prices, fuel and processing expenses all feed into the final shelf price.
segments.tr: - **Costos de alimentación y energía.** Los precios de los granos, el combustible y los gastos de procesamiento influyen en el precio final en estantería.

segments.src: - **Retail strategy.** Many grocery chains treat turkey as a "loss leader." They discount it heavily, sometimes in exchange for a minimum purchase, to bring shoppers into the store.
segments.tr: - **Estrategia minorista.** Muchas cadenas de supermercados tratan al pavo como un "producto gancho". Lo descuentan considerablemente, a veces a cambio de una compra mínima, para atraer a los compradores a la tienda.

segments.src: - **Timing.** Frozen turkeys are often cheapest in the weeks right before the holiday, while fresh birds usually cost more per pound.
segments.tr: - **Tiempos.** Los pavos congelados suelen ser más baratos en las semanas previas a la festividad, mientras que las aves frescas suelen costar más por libra.

segments.src: ## Dairy: Butter, Cream and Milk
segments.tr: ## Lácteos: mantequilla, crema y leche

segments.src: Dairy shows up in mashed potatoes, casseroles, rolls and pie fillings.
segments.tr: Los lácteos aparecen en el puré de papas, las cazuelas, los panecillos y los rellenos de pastel.

segments.src: Prices follow milk supply, feed costs, seasonal demand and trade conditions.
segments.tr: Los precios siguen el suministro de leche, los costos de alimentación, la demanda estacional y las condiciones comerciales.

segments.src: Butter and cream tend to be more volatile than milk, and demand rises sharply in the weeks around the holidays.
segments.tr: La mantequilla y la crema tienden a ser más volátiles que la leche, y la demanda aumenta considerablemente en las semanas cercanas a las fiestas.

segments.src: Store brands are often noticeably cheaper than name brands for the same ingredient.
segments.tr: Las marcas de la tienda suelen ser notablemente más baratas que las marcas reconocidas para el mismo ingrediente.

segments.src: ## Produce: Weather and Transportation
segments.tr: ## Productos agrícolas: clima y transporte

segments.src: Fresh vegetables, cranberries, sweet potatoes and potatoes are sensitive to weather, harvest conditions and transportation costs.
segments.tr: Las verduras frescas, los arándanos, los camotes y las papas son sensibles al clima, las condiciones de cosecha y los costos de transporte.

segments.src: A poor growing season in one region can lift prices nationally, while a strong harvest can keep them steady.
segments.tr: Una mala temporada de cultivo en una región puede elevar los precios a nivel nacional, mientras que una buena cosecha puede mantenerlos estables.

segments.src: Canned and frozen versions of many items are often cheaper and last longer, which makes them a practical option for the side dishes.
segments.tr: Las versiones enlatadas y congeladas de muchos artículos suelen ser más baratas y duran más, lo que las convierte en una opción práctica para los acompañamientos.

segments.src: ## Stuffing, Rolls and Pie
segments.tr: ## Relleno, panecillos y pastel

segments.src: Packaged stuffing mix, bread, flour, sugar and pie crusts depend largely on wheat, sugar and packaging costs.
segments.tr: La mezcla de relleno empaquetada, el pan, la harina, el azúcar y las cortezas de pastel dependen en gran medida de los costos del trigo, el azúcar y el empaque.

segments.src: Pumpkin and pecan pie ingredients can swing with crop conditions.
segments.tr: Los ingredientes para el pastel de calabaza y nuez pecana pueden variar según las condiciones de la cosecha.

segments.src: Many shoppers save money by baking from scratch, while others find a store-bought pie cheaper once their time and extra ingredients are counted.
segments.tr: Muchos compradores ahorran dinero horneando desde cero, mientras que otros encuentran que un pastel comprado en la tienda es más barato una vez que se cuenta su tiempo y los ingredientes adicionales.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Annual Dinner-Cost Surveys
segments.tr: ## Cómo leer las encuestas anuales sobre el costo de la cena

segments.src: Several organizations publish a yearly estimate of the cost of a Thanksgiving dinner.
segments.tr: Varias organizaciones publican una estimación anual del costo de una cena de Acción de Gracias.

segments.src: The best known is the American Farm Bureau Federation's survey, which prices a classic menu for a set number of guests, typically ten, using reports from volunteer shoppers across the country.
segments.tr: La más conocida es la encuesta de la American Farm Bureau Federation, que pone precio a un menú clásico para un número determinado de invitados, generalmente diez, utilizando informes de compradores voluntarios de todo el país.

segments.src: Some retailers and consumer groups publish their own versions.
segments.tr: Algunos minoristas y grupos de consumidores publican sus propias versiones.

segments.src: A few points help put these numbers in context:
segments.tr: Algunos puntos ayudan a poner estas cifras en contexto:

segments.src: 1. **Check the menu.** Surveys price a specific list of items. If your table has more dishes, different dishes or a larger crowd, your total will differ.
segments.tr: 1. **Revise el menú.** Las encuestas ponen precio a una lista específica de artículos. Si su mesa tiene más platos, platos diferentes o un grupo más grande, su total será diferente.

segments.src: 2. **Look at the method.** Some surveys use regular shelf prices, while others include promotions. Results can differ by several dollars for that reason alone.
segments.tr: 2. **Observe el método.** Algunas encuestas utilizan precios regulares de estantería, mientras que otras incluyen promociones. Los resultados pueden diferir en varios dólares solo por esa razón.

segments.src: 3. **Compare like with like.** A survey from one organization is not directly comparable to a survey from another.
segments.tr: 3. **Compare lo comparable.** Una encuesta de una organización no es directamente comparable con la encuesta de otra.

segments.src: 4. **Remember it's an average.** Prices in a big city, a rural town and a discount grocer can differ widely.
segments.tr: 4. **Recuerde que es un promedio.** Los precios en una gran ciudad, un pueblo rural y una tienda de descuento pueden diferir ampliamente.

segments.src: 5. **Watch the trend, not the decimal.** A small change from last year may not mean much. A larger shift, and what caused it, is more informative.
segments.tr: 5. **Observe la tendencia, no el decimal.** Un pequeño cambio respecto al año pasado puede no significar mucho. Un cambio mayor, y lo que lo causó, es más informativo.

segments.src: 6. **Note the timing.** Prices are collected weeks before the holiday, and store sales may change what you actually pay.
segments.tr: 6. **Tenga en cuenta el momento.** Los precios se recopilan semanas antes de la festividad, y las ofertas de las tiendas pueden cambiar lo que realmente paga.

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Keep the Bill in Check
segments.tr: ## Formas prácticas de mantener la factura bajo control

segments.src: - **Make a menu and a list first.** Planning cuts impulse purchases and food waste.
segments.tr: - **Haga primero un menú y una lista.** La planificación reduce las compras impulsivas y el desperdicio de alimentos.

segments.src: - **Compare unit prices.** The price per pound or per ounce shows the real value better than the sticker price.
segments.tr: - **Compare los precios unitarios.** El precio por libra o por onza muestra el valor real mejor que el precio de etiqueta.

segments.src: - **Use store promotions and loyalty programs,** but check whether a turkey deal requires a minimum spend.
segments.tr: - **Utilice promociones de la tienda y programas de lealtad,** pero verifique si una oferta de pavo requiere un gasto mínimo.

segments.src: - **Consider alternatives.** A smaller bird, a turkey breast or a different main dish can lower costs for a smaller group.
segments.tr: - **Considere alternativas.** Un ave más pequeña, una pechuga de pavo o un plato principal diferente pueden reducir los costos para un grupo más pequeño.

segments.src: - **Buy shelf-stable items early** and watch for sales on baking staples.
segments.tr: - **Compre artículos no perecederos con anticipación** y esté atento a las ofertas en productos básicos para hornear.

segments.src: - **Share the load.** Asking guests to bring a side dish or dessert spreads out the expense.
segments.tr: - **Comparta la carga.** Pedir a los invitados que traigan un acompañamiento o postre distribuye el gasto.

segments.src: - **Plan for leftovers** so less food goes to waste.
segments.tr: - **Planifique las sobras** para que se desperdicie menos comida.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: Nobody can say exactly what your Thanksgiving table will cost until you are at the checkout.
segments.tr: Nadie puede decir exactamente cuánto costará su mesa de Acción de Gracias hasta que esté en la caja.

segments.src: Still, understanding what moves the price of turkey, dairy and produce, and knowing how the annual surveys are built, can help you separate real trends from headlines.
segments.tr: Aun así, comprender qué mueve el precio del pavo, los lácteos y los productos agrícolas, y saber cómo se elaboran las encuestas anuales, puede ayudarle a separar las tendencias reales de los titulares.

segments.src: A little planning and some comparison shopping will usually do more for your budget than any national average.
segments.tr: Un poco de planificación y comparar precios generalmente hará más por su presupuesto que cualquier promedio nacional.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Annual Dinner-Cost Surveys

segments.src: Some retailers and consumer groups publish their own versions.

segments.src: A few points help put these numbers in context:

segments.src: 1. **Check the menu.** Surveys price a specific list of items. If your table has more dishes, different dishes or a larger crowd, your total will differ.
segments.tr: 1. **تحقق من القائمة.** تحدد الاستطلاعات أسعار قائمة محددة من العناصر. إذا كانت طاولتك تحتوي على أطباق أكثر، أو أطباق مختلفة، أو جمع أكبر، فإن المجموع الكلي سَيختلف.

segments.src: 2. **Look at the method.** Some surveys use regular shelf prices, while others include promotions. Results can differ by several dollars for that reason alone.
segments.tr: 2. **انظر إلى المنهجية.** تستخدم بعض الاستطلاعات أسعار الرف العادية، بينما تتضمن استطلاعات أخرى العروض الترويجية. يمكن أن تختلف النتائج بعدة دولارات لهذا السبب وحده.

segments.src: 3. **Compare like with like.** A survey from one organization is not directly comparable to a survey from another.
segments.tr: 3. **قارن بين الأمور المتشابهة.** الاستطلاع الصادر عن منظمة ما لا يمكن مقارنته بشكل مباشر باستطلاع من منظمة أخرى.

segments.src: 4. **Remember it's an average.** Prices in a big city, a rural town and a discount grocer can differ widely.
segments.tr: 4. **تذكر أنه متوسط.** يمكن أن تختلف الأسعار في مدينة كبيرة، وبلدة ريفية، ومتجر تخفيضات بشكل كبير.

segments.src: 5. **Watch the trend, not the decimal.** A small change from last year may not mean much. A larger shift, and what caused it, is more informative.

segments.src: 6. **Note the timing.** Prices are collected weeks before the holiday, and store sales may change what you actually pay.
segments.tr: 6. **لاحظ التوقيت.** تُجمع الأسعار قبل أسابيع من العطلة، وقد تتغير مبيعات المتجر ما تدفعه بالفعل.

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Keep the Bill in Check

segments.src: - **Make a menu and a list first.** Planning cuts impulse purchases and food waste.
segments.tr: - **قم بإنشاء قائمة طعام وقائمة مشتريات أولاً.** التخطيط يقلل من الشراء الاندفاعي وإهدار الطعام.

segments.src: - **Use store promotions and loyalty programs,** but check whether a turkey deal requires a minimum spend.

segments.src: - **Consider alternatives.** A smaller bird, a turkey breast or a different main dish can lower costs for a smaller group.
segments.tr: - **فكر في البدائل.** يمكن لطير أصغر، أو صدر ديك رومي، أو طبق رئيسي مختلف أن يقلل التكاليف لمجموعة أصغر.

segments.src: - **Buy shelf-stable items early** and watch for sales on baking staples.

fr.title: L'addition du repas de Thanksgiving : ce que la dinde, la farce et la tarte pourraient coûter cette année

segments.src: With Thanksgiving about five weeks away, the cost of the holiday meal is already a popular topic at kitchen tables and in grocery aisles.
segments.tr: Alors que Thanksgiving a lieu dans environ cinq semaines, le coût du repas de fête est déjà un sujet de conversation populaire autour de la table et dans les rayons des supermarchés.

segments.src: Households that host a big dinner often start planning early, and many want to know whether the familiar menu of turkey, stuffing, vegetables and pie will cost more or less than last year.
segments.tr: Les ménages qui organisent un grand dîner commencent souvent à planifier tôt, et beaucoup veulent savoir si le menu habituel composé de dinde, de farce, de légumes et de tarte coûtera plus ou moins cher que l'année dernière.

segments.src: This guide explains what tends to drive the price of the main ingredients and how to read the annual dinner-cost surveys without over-interpreting a single headline number.
segments.tr: Ce guide explique ce qui tend à influencer le prix des principaux ingrédients et comment interpréter les enquêtes annuelles sur le coût du dîner sans surinterpréter un simple chiffre à la une.

segments.src: It does not predict exact prices.
segments.tr: Il ne prédit pas les prix exacts.

segments.src: Costs vary by region, store and week.
segments.tr: Les coûts varient selon la région, le magasin et la semaine.

segments.src: ## Why Thanksgiving Prices Get So Much Attention
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les prix de Thanksgiving attirent autant l'attention

segments.src: Thanksgiving is one of the few meals in the United States built around a nearly standard menu.
segments.tr: Thanksgiving est l'un des rares repas aux États-Unis élaboré autour d'un menu presque standard.

segments.src: That makes it a convenient yardstick.
segments.tr: Cela en fait un point de référence pratique.

segments.src: Because most households buy a similar set of items, changes in the total are easy to compare from one year to the next.
segments.tr: Comme la plupart des ménages achètent un ensemble d'articles similaires, les variations du total sont faciles à comparer d'une année sur l'autre.

segments.src: The meal also stands in for broader grocery inflation, so a rise or fall in the "dinner bill" often shapes conversations about everyday food costs.
segments.tr: Ce repas sert également d'indicateur pour l'inflation alimentaire globale, de sorte qu'une hausse ou une baisse de « l'addition du dîner » façonne souvent les discussions sur le coût de la nourriture au quotidien.

segments.src: ## Turkey: Supply, Disease and Timing
segments.tr: ## Dinde : offre, maladies et calendrier

segments.src: The turkey is usually the most expensive single item, and its price depends on several factors:
segments.tr: La dinde est généralement l'article individuel le plus cher, et son prix dépend de plusieurs facteurs :

segments.src: - **Flock size.** Producers decide months ahead how many birds to raise. Outbreaks of avian influenza can shrink flocks and tighten supply, which has pushed turkey prices up in past years.
segments.tr: - **Taille de l'élevage.** Les producteurs décident des mois à l'avance du nombre d'oiseaux à élever. Les épidémies de grippe aviaire peuvent réduire la taille des élevages et tendre l'offre, ce qui a fait grimper les prix de la dinde les années passées.

segments.src: - **Feed and energy costs.** Grain prices, fuel and processing expenses all feed into the final shelf price.
segments.tr: - **Coûts de l'alimentation et de l'énergie.** Le prix des céréales, le carburant et les frais de transformation se répercutent tous sur le prix final en rayon.

segments.src: - **Retail strategy.** Many grocery chains treat turkey as a "loss leader." They discount it heavily, sometimes in exchange for a minimum purchase, to bring shoppers into the store.
segments.tr: - **Stratégie des distributeurs.** De nombreuses chaînes de supermarchés utilisent la dinde comme « produit d'appel ». Elles la bradent fortement, parfois en échange d'un montant d'achat minimum, pour attirer les clients dans le magasin.

segments.src: - **Timing.** Frozen turkeys are often cheapest in the weeks right before the holiday, while fresh birds usually cost more per pound.
segments.tr: - **Calendrier.** Les dindes congelées sont souvent les moins chères dans les semaines qui précèdent immédiatement la fête, tandis que les dindes fraîches coûtent généralement plus cher au kilo.

segments.src: ## Dairy: Butter, Cream and Milk
segments.tr: ## Produits laitiers : beurre, crème et lait

segments.src: Dairy shows up in mashed potatoes, casseroles, rolls and pie fillings.
segments.tr: Les produits laitiers sont présents dans la purée de pommes de terre, les gratins, les petits pains et les garnitures de tartes.

segments.src: Prices follow milk supply, feed costs, seasonal demand and trade conditions.
segments.tr: Les prix suivent l'offre de lait, le coût de l'alimentation animale, la demande saisonnière et les conditions du marché.

segments.src: Butter and cream tend to be more volatile than milk, and demand rises sharply in the weeks around the holidays.
segments.tr: Le beurre et la crème ont tendance à être plus volatils que le lait, et la demande augmente fortement durant les semaines entourant les fêtes.

segments.src: Store brands are often noticeably cheaper than name brands for the same ingredient.
segments.tr: Les marques de distributeurs sont souvent nettement moins chères que les grandes marques pour un même ingrédient.

segments.src: ## Produce: Weather and Transportation
segments.tr: ## Produits frais : météo et transport

segments.src: Fresh vegetables, cranberries, sweet potatoes and potatoes are sensitive to weather, harvest conditions and transportation costs.
segments.tr: Les légumes frais, les canneberges, les patates douces et les pommes de terre sont sensibles aux conditions météorologiques, aux récoltes et aux coûts de transport.

segments.src: A poor growing season in one region can lift prices nationally, while a strong harvest can keep them steady.
segments.tr: Une mauvaise saison de culture dans une région peut faire monter les prix à l'échelle nationale, tandis qu'une récolte abondante peut les maintenir stables.

segments.src: Canned and frozen versions of many items are often cheaper and last longer, which makes them a practical option for the side dishes.
segments.tr: Les versions en conserve et surgelées de nombreux articles sont souvent moins chères et se conservent plus longtemps, ce qui en fait une option pratique pour les accompagnements.

segments.src: ## Stuffing, Rolls and Pie
segments.tr: ## Farce, petits pains et tartes

segments.src: Packaged stuffing mix, bread, flour, sugar and pie crusts depend largely on wheat, sugar and packaging costs.
segments.tr: Le mélange de farce prêt à l'emploi, le pain, la farine, le sucre et les pâtes à tarte dépendent largement des coûts du blé, du sucre et de l'emballage.

segments.src: Pumpkin and pecan pie ingredients can swing with crop conditions.
segments.tr: Les ingrédients pour la tarte à la citrouille et la tarte aux noix de pécan peuvent fluctuer selon les conditions de récolte.

segments.src: Many shoppers save money by baking from scratch, while others find a store-bought pie cheaper once their time and extra ingredients are counted.
segments.tr: De nombreux consommateurs économisent de l'argent en cuisinant eux-mêmes, tandis que d'autres trouvent qu'une tarte achetée en magasin est moins chère une fois qu'ils prennent en compte leur temps et les ingrédients supplémentaires.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Annual Dinner-Cost Surveys
segments.tr: ## Comment lire les enquêtes annuelles sur le coût du dîner

segments.src: Several organizations publish a yearly estimate of the cost of a Thanksgiving dinner.
segments.tr: Plusieurs organismes publient une estimation annuelle du coût d'un dîner de Thanksgiving.

segments.src: The best known is the American Farm Bureau Federation's survey, which prices a classic menu for a set number of guests, typically ten, using reports from volunteer shoppers across the country.
segments.tr: La plus connue est l'enquête de l'American Farm Bureau Federation, qui évalue le prix d'un menu classique pour un nombre défini d'invités, généralement dix, en utilisant les rapports d'acheteurs bénévoles à travers le pays.

segments.src: Some retailers and consumer groups publish their own versions.
segments.tr: Certains distributeurs et groupes de consommateurs publient leurs propres versions.

segments.src: A few points help put these numbers in context:
segments.tr: Quelques points aident à replacer ces chiffres dans leur contexte :

segments.src: 1. **Check the menu.** Surveys price a specific list of items. If your table has more dishes, different dishes or a larger crowd, your total will differ.
segments.tr: 1. **Vérifiez le menu.** Les enquêtes évaluent une liste précise d'articles. Si votre table comporte plus de plats, des plats différents ou un plus grand nombre d'invités, votre total sera différent.

segments.src: 2. **Look at the method.** Some surveys use regular shelf prices, while others include promotions. Results can differ by several dollars for that reason alone.
segments.tr: 2. **Examinez la méthode.** Certaines enquêtes utilisent les prix habituels en rayon, tandis que d'autres incluent les promotions. Les résultats peuvent différer de plusieurs dollars pour cette seule raison.

segments.src: 3. **Compare like with like.** A survey from one organization is not directly comparable to a survey from another.
segments.tr: 3. **Comparez ce qui est comparable.** Une enquête provenant d'un organisme n'est pas directement comparable à l'enquête d'un autre.

segments.src: 4. **Remember it's an average.** Prices in a big city, a rural town and a discount grocer can differ widely.
segments.tr: 4. **Rappelez-vous qu'il s'agit d'une moyenne.** Les prix dans une grande ville, une commune rurale ou un supermarché discount peuvent varier considérablement.

segments.src: 5. **Watch the trend, not the decimal.** A small change from last year may not mean much. A larger shift, and what caused it, is more informative.
segments.tr: 5. **Suivez la tendance, pas les décimales.** Une petite variation par rapport à l'année dernière peut ne pas signifier grand-chose. Un changement plus important, et ce qui l'a causé, est plus informatif.

segments.src: 6. **Note the timing.** Prices are collected weeks before the holiday, and store sales may change what you actually pay.
segments.tr: 6. **Notez le moment du relevé.** Les prix sont collectés plusieurs semaines avant la fête, et les promotions en magasin peuvent modifier ce que vous payez réellement.

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Keep the Bill in Check
segments.tr: ## Moyens pratiques de maîtriser l'addition

segments.src: - **Make a menu and a list first.** Planning cuts impulse purchases and food waste.
segments.tr: - **Faites d'abord un menu et une liste.** La planification réduit les achats impulsifs et le gaspillage alimentaire.

segments.src: - **Compare unit prices.** The price per pound or per ounce shows the real value better than the sticker price.
segments.tr: - **Comparez les prix au kilo ou à l'unité.** Le prix au kilo ou à la pièce reflète mieux la valeur réelle que le prix affiché.

segments.src: - **Use store promotions and loyalty programs,** but check whether a turkey deal requires a minimum spend.
segments.tr: - **Profitez des promotions en magasin et des programmes de fidélité,** mais vérifiez si une offre sur la dinde exige un montant d'achat minimum.

segments.src: - **Consider alternatives.** A smaller bird, a turkey breast or a different main dish can lower costs for a smaller group.
segments.tr: - **Envisagez des alternatives.** Une dinde plus petite, un blanc de dinde ou un plat principal différent peuvent réduire les coûts pour un groupe plus restreint.

segments.src: - **Buy shelf-stable items early** and watch for sales on baking staples.
segments.tr: - **Achetez tôt les produits non périssables** et guettez les promotions sur les ingrédients de base pour la pâtisserie.

segments.src: - **Share the load.** Asking guests to bring a side dish or dessert spreads out the expense.
segments.tr: - **Partagez les frais.** Demander aux invités d'apporter un accompagnement ou un dessert permet de répartir la dépense.

segments.src: - **Plan for leftovers** so less food goes to waste.
segments.tr: - **Prévoyez l'utilisation des restes** pour éviter le gaspillage d'aliments.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En conclusion

segments.src: Nobody can say exactly what your Thanksgiving table will cost until you are at the checkout.
segments.tr: Personne ne peut dire exactement combien coûtera votre repas de Thanksgiving tant que vous ne passerez pas à la caisse.

segments.src: Still, understanding what moves the price of turkey, dairy and produce, and knowing how the annual surveys are built, can help you separate real trends from headlines.
segments.tr: Pourtant, comprendre ce qui fait varier le prix de la dinde, des produits laitiers et des fruits et légumes, et savoir comment sont construites les enquêtes annuelles, peut vous aider à distinguer les vraies tendances des simples titres d'actualité.

segments.src: A little planning and some comparison shopping will usually do more for your budget than any national average.

segments.src: The turkey is usually the most expensive single item, and its price depends on several factors:

segments.src: - **Flock size.** Producers decide months ahead how many birds to raise. Outbreaks of avian influenza can shrink flocks and tighten supply, which has pushed turkey prices up in past years.
segments.tr: - **Tamanho do rebanho.** Os produtores decidem com meses de antecedência quantas aves criar. Surtos de gripe aviária podem reduzir os rebanhos e diminuir a oferta, o que elevou os preços do peru em anos anteriores.

segments.src: - **Feed and energy costs.** Grain prices, fuel and processing expenses all feed into the final shelf price.
segments.tr: - **Custos de ração e energia.** Preços de grãos, combustível e despesas de processamento influenciam o preço final nas prateleiras.

segments.src: - **Retail strategy.** Many grocery chains treat turkey as a "loss leader." They discount it heavily, sometimes in exchange for a minimum purchase, to bring shoppers into the store.
segments.tr: - **Estratégia do varejo.** Muitas redes de supermercados usam o peru como um "produto chamariz" (loss leader). Elas dão grandes descontos, às vezes em troca de um valor mínimo de compra, para atrair clientes para a loja.

segments.src: - **Timing.** Frozen turkeys are often cheapest in the weeks right before the holiday, while fresh birds usually cost more per pound.
segments.tr: - **Época.** Perus congelados costumam ser mais baratos nas semanas que antecedem o feriado, enquanto aves frescas geralmente custam mais por quilo.

segments.src: ## Dairy: Butter, Cream and Milk
segments.tr: ## Laticínios: Manteiga, Creme de Leite e Leite

segments.src: Dairy shows up in mashed potatoes, casseroles, rolls and pie fillings.
segments.tr: Os laticínios estão presentes no purê de batatas, em assados, pães e recheios de tortas.

segments.src: Prices follow milk supply, feed costs, seasonal demand and trade conditions.
segments.tr: Os preços acompanham a oferta de leite, os custos da ração, a demanda sazonal e as condições comerciais.

segments.src: Butter and cream tend to be more volatile than milk, and demand rises sharply in the weeks around the holidays.
segments.tr: Manteiga e creme de leite tendem a ser mais voláteis do que o leite, e a demanda aumenta acentuadamente nas semanas ao redor dos feriados.

segments.src: Store brands are often noticeably cheaper than name brands for the same ingredient.
segments.tr: Marcas próprias dos supermercados costumam ser notavelmente mais baratas do que as marcas famosas para o mesmo ingrediente.

segments.src: ## Produce: Weather and Transportation
segments.tr: ## Hortifrúti: Clima e Transporte

segments.src: Fresh vegetables, cranberries, sweet potatoes and potatoes are sensitive to weather, harvest conditions and transportation costs.
segments.tr: Legumes frescos, cranberries, batatas-doces e batatas são sensíveis ao clima, às condições de colheita e aos custos de transporte.

segments.src: A poor growing season in one region can lift prices nationally, while a strong harvest can keep them steady.
segments.tr: Uma safra ruim em uma região pode elevar os preços nacionalmente, enquanto uma colheita forte pode mantê-los estáveis.

segments.src: Canned and frozen versions of many items are often cheaper and last longer, which makes them a practical option for the side dishes.
segments.tr: Versões em conserva e congeladas de muitos itens costumam ser mais baratas e duram mais, tornando-se uma opção prática para os acompanhamentos.

segments.src: ## Stuffing, Rolls and Pie
segments.tr: ## Recheio, Pães e Tortas

segments.src: Packaged stuffing mix, bread, flour, sugar and pie crusts depend largely on wheat, sugar and packaging costs.
segments.tr: Misturas prontas para recheio, pães, farinha, açúcar e massas de torta dependem em grande parte dos custos do trigo, do açúcar e das embalagens.

segments.src: Pumpkin and pecan pie ingredients can swing with crop conditions.
segments.tr: Ingredientes para torta de abóbora e noz-pecã podem oscilar conforme as condições das safras.

segments.src: Many shoppers save money by baking from scratch, while others find a store-bought pie cheaper once their time and extra ingredients are counted.
segments.tr: Muitos consumidores economizam fazendo tudo do zero, enquanto outros acham que comprar uma torta pronta é mais barato depois de contabilizar seu tempo e ingredientes extras.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Annual Dinner-Cost Surveys
segments.tr: ## Como Interpretar as Pesquisas Anuais de Custo do Jantar

segments.src: Several organizations publish a yearly estimate of the cost of a Thanksgiving dinner.
segments.tr: Várias organizações publicam uma estimativa anual do custo do jantar de Ação de Graças.

segments.src: The best known is the American Farm Bureau Federation's survey, which prices a classic menu for a set number of guests, typically ten, using reports from volunteer shoppers across the country.
segments.tr: A mais conhecida é a pesquisa da American Farm Bureau Federation, que calcula o preço de um menu clássico para um número fixo de convidados, tipicamente dez, usando relatos de compradores voluntários em todo o país.

segments.src: Some retailers and consumer groups publish their own versions.
segments.tr: Alguns varejistas e grupos de consumidores publicam suas próprias versões.

segments.src: A few points help put these numbers in context:
segments.tr: Alguns pontos ajudam a colocar esses números em contexto:

segments.src: 1. **Check the menu.** Surveys price a specific list of items. If your table has more dishes, different dishes or a larger crowd, your total will differ.
segments.tr: 1. **Verifique o menu.** As pesquisas calculam o preço de uma lista específica de itens. Se a sua mesa tiver mais pratos, pratos diferentes ou um grupo maior, seu total será diferente.

segments.src: 2. **Look at the method.** Some surveys use regular shelf prices, while others include promotions. Results can differ by several dollars for that reason alone.
segments.tr: 2. **Observe a metodologia.** Algumas pesquisas usam os preços regulares de prateleira, enquanto outras incluem promoções. Os resultados podem diferir em vários dólares só por esse motivo.

segments.src: 3. **Compare like with like.** A survey from one organization is not directly comparable to a survey from another.
segments.tr: 3. **Compare o que é comparável.** Uma pesquisa de uma organização não é diretamente comparável à pesquisa de outra.

segments.src: 4. **Remember it's an average.** Prices in a big city, a rural town and a discount grocer can differ widely.
segments.tr: 4. **Lembre-se de que é uma média.** Os preços em uma cidade grande, em uma cidade rural e em um supermercado de desconto podem diferir bastante.

segments.src: 5. **Watch the trend, not the decimal.** A small change from last year may not mean much. A larger shift, and what caused it, is more informative.
segments.tr: 5. **Acompanhe a tendência, não as casas decimais.** Uma pequena variação em relação ao ano passado pode não significar muito. Uma mudança maior, e o que a causou, traz mais informações.

segments.src: 6. **Note the timing.** Prices are collected weeks before the holiday, and store sales may change what you actually pay.
segments.tr: 6. **Atenção ao momento.** Os preços são coletados semanas antes do feriado, e as promoções nas lojas podem alterar o que você realmente paga.

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Keep the Bill in Check
segments.tr: ## Maneiras Práticas de Manter a Conta Sob Controle

segments.src: - **Make a menu and a list first.** Planning cuts impulse purchases and food waste.
segments.tr: - **Faça um menu e uma lista primeiro.** O planejamento reduz compras por impulso e desperdício de comida.

segments.src: - **Compare unit prices.** The price per pound or per ounce shows the real value better than the sticker price.
segments.tr: - **Compare os preços por unidade.** O preço por quilo ou por grama mostra o valor real melhor do que o preço da etiqueta.

segments.src: - **Use store promotions and loyalty programs,** but check whether a turkey deal requires a minimum spend.
segments.tr: - **Aproveite as promoções das lojas e programas de fidelidade,** mas verifique se uma oferta de peru exige um valor mínimo de compra.

segments.src: - **Consider alternatives.** A smaller bird, a turkey breast or a different main dish can lower costs for a smaller group.
segments.tr: - **Considere alternativas.** Uma ave menor, um peito de peru ou um prato principal diferente podem reduzir os custos para um grupo menor.

segments.src: - **Buy shelf-stable items early** and watch for sales on baking staples.
segments.tr: - **Compre itens não perecíveis com antecedência** e fique atento às promoções de ingredientes básicos para confeitaria.

segments.src: - **Share the load.** Asking guests to bring a side dish or dessert spreads out the expense.
segments.tr: - **Divida as tarefas.** Pedir aos convidados que tragam um acompanhamento ou sobremesa distribui as despesas.

segments.src: - **Plan for leftovers** so less food goes to waste.
segments.tr: - **Planeje o uso das sobras** para que menos comida seja desperdiçada.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## O Resultado Final

segments.src: Nobody can say exactly what your Thanksgiving table will cost until you are at the checkout.
segments.tr: Ninguém pode dizer exatamente quanto custará a sua mesa de Ação de Graças até você passar pelo caixa.

segments.src: Still, understanding what moves the price of turkey, dairy and produce, and knowing how the annual surveys are built, can help you separate real trends from headlines.
segments.tr: Ainda assim, entender o que move o preço do peru, dos laticínios e do hortifrúti, e saber como as pesquisas anuais são estruturadas, pode ajudá-lo a separar as tendências reais das manchetes.

segments.src: A little planning and some comparison shopping will usually do more for your budget than any national average.
segments.tr: Um pouco de planejamento e alguma pesquisa de preços geralmente farão mais pelo seu orçamento do que qualquer média nacional.

segments.tr: Os preços variam por local e estabelecimento comercial.*

segments.src: Households that host a big dinner often start planning early, and many want to know whether the familiar menu of turkey, stuffing, vegetables and pie will cost more or less than last year.
segments.tr: Rumah tangga yang mengadakan makan malam besar sering kali mulai merencanakan lebih awal, dan banyak yang ingin tahu apakah menu yang sudah dikenal seperti kalkun, isian, sayuran, dan pai akan memakan biaya lebih mahal atau lebih murah daripada tahun lalu.

segments.src: ## Why Thanksgiving Prices Get So Much Attention
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Harga Thanksgiving Mendapat Begitu Banyak Perhatian

segments.src: Thanksgiving is one of the few meals in the United States built around a nearly standard menu.
segments.tr: Thanksgiving adalah salah satu dari sedikit waktu makan di Amerika Serikat yang dibangun di sekitar menu yang hampir standar.

segments.src: That makes it a convenient yardstick.
segments.tr: Hal itu menjadikannya tolok ukur yang nyaman.

segments.src: Because most households buy a similar set of items, changes in the total are easy to compare from one year to the next.
segments.tr: Karena sebagian besar rumah tangga membeli rangkaian barang yang serupa, perubahan totalnya mudah dibandingkan dari tahun ke tahun.

segments.src: The meal also stands in for broader grocery inflation, so a rise or fall in the "dinner bill" often shapes conversations about everyday food costs.
segments.tr: Hidangan ini juga mewakili inflasi bahan makanan yang lebih luas, sehingga kenaikan atau penurunan "tagihan makan malam" sering kali membentuk percakapan tentang biaya makanan sehari-hari.

segments.src: ## Turkey: Supply, Disease and Timing
segments.tr: ## Kalkun: Pasokan, Penyakit, dan Waktu

segments.src: The turkey is usually the most expensive single item, and its price depends on several factors:
segments.tr: Kalkun biasanya merupakan barang tunggal yang paling mahal, dan harganya bergantung pada beberapa faktor:

segments.src: - **Flock size.** Producers decide months ahead how many birds to raise. Outbreaks of avian influenza can shrink flocks and tighten supply, which has pushed turkey prices up in past years.
segments.tr: - **Ukuran kawanan.** Produsen memutuskan berbulan-bulan sebelumnya berapa banyak burung yang akan dipelihara. Wabah flu burung dapat menyusutkan kawanan dan memperketat pasokan, yang telah mendorong harga kalkun naik dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.

segments.src: - **Feed and energy costs.** Grain prices, fuel and processing expenses all feed into the final shelf price.
segments.tr: - **Biaya pakan dan energi.** Harga biji-bijian, bahan bakar, dan biaya pemrosesan semuanya memengaruhi harga akhir di rak.

segments.src: - **Retail strategy.** Many grocery chains treat turkey as a "loss leader." They discount it heavily, sometimes in exchange for a minimum purchase, to bring shoppers into the store.
segments.tr: - **Strategi ritel.** Banyak jaringan toko bahan makanan memperlakukan kalkun sebagai "loss leader" (produk yang dijual rugi untuk menarik pelanggan). Mereka memberikan diskon besar, terkadang dengan syarat pembelian minimum, untuk menarik pembeli datang ke toko.

segments.src: - **Timing.** Frozen turkeys are often cheapest in the weeks right before the holiday, while fresh birds usually cost more per pound.
segments.tr: - **Waktu.** Kalkun beku sering kali paling murah pada minggu-minggu tepat sebelum liburan, sementara burung segar biasanya lebih mahal per pon.

segments.src: ## Dairy: Butter, Cream and Milk
segments.tr: ## Produk Susu: Mentega, Krim, dan Susu

segments.src: Butter and cream tend to be more volatile than milk, and demand rises sharply in the weeks around the holidays.
segments.tr: Mentega dan krim cenderung lebih fluktuatif daripada susu, dan permintaan meningkat tajam pada minggu-minggu sekitar hari libur.

segments.src: Store brands are often noticeably cheaper than name brands for the same ingredient.
segments.tr: Merek toko sering kali jauh lebih murah daripada merek ternama untuk bahan yang sama.

segments.src: ## Produce: Weather and Transportation

segments.src: ## Turkey: Supply, Disease and Timing

segments.src: The turkey is usually the most expensive single item, and its price depends on several factors:
segments.tr: 七面鳥は通常、単一の品目の中で最も高価であり、その価格はいくつかの要因に左右される：

segments.src: - **Flock size.** Producers decide months ahead how many birds to raise. Outbreaks of avian influenza can shrink flocks and tighten supply, which has pushed turkey prices up in past years.
segments.tr: - **群れの規模。** 生産者は何羽飼育するかを何ヶ月も前に決定する。鳥インフルエンザの発生により群れが縮小して供給がひっ迫することがあり、過去数年間は七面鳥の価格が上昇している。

segments.src: - **Feed and energy costs.** Grain prices, fuel and processing expenses all feed into the final shelf price.
segments.tr: - **飼料とエネルギーのコスト。** 穀物価格、燃料、加工費のすべてが最終的な店頭価格に反映される。

segments.src: - **Retail strategy.** Many grocery chains treat turkey as a "loss leader." They discount it heavily, sometimes in exchange for a minimum purchase, to bring shoppers into the store.
segments.tr: - **小売戦略。** 多くの食料品チェーンは七面鳥を「ロスリーダー」として扱う。買い手を店舗に呼び込むため、最低購入金額を条件にするなどして大幅に値引きすることがある。

segments.src: - **Timing.** Frozen turkeys are often cheapest in the weeks right before the holiday, while fresh birds usually cost more per pound.
segments.tr: - **タイミング。** 冷凍の七面鳥は通常、祝日の直前の週に最も安くなる一方、生鮮の鳥は通常ポンドあたりの価格が高くなる。

segments.src: ## Dairy: Butter, Cream and Milk
segments.tr: ## 乳製品：バター、クリーム、牛乳

segments.src: Dairy shows up in mashed potatoes, casseroles, rolls and pie fillings.
segments.tr: 乳製品は、マッシュポテト、キャセロール、ロールパン、パイのフィリングに使われる。

segments.src: Prices follow milk supply, feed costs, seasonal demand and trade conditions.
segments.tr: 価格は牛乳の供給、飼料コスト、季節的な需要、貿易の状況に従う。

segments.src: Butter and cream tend to be more volatile than milk, and demand rises sharply in the weeks around the holidays.
segments.tr: バターとクリームは牛乳よりも変動しやすく、祝日を控えた数週間に需要が急増する。

segments.src: Store brands are often noticeably cheaper than name brands for the same ingredient.
segments.tr: 同じ食材でも、ストアブランドはメーカーブランドよりもかなり安いことが多い。

segments.src: ## Produce: Weather and Transportation
segments.tr: ## 農産物：天候と輸送

segments.src: Fresh vegetables, cranberries, sweet potatoes and potatoes are sensitive to weather, harvest conditions and transportation costs.
segments.tr: 生鮮野菜、クランベリー、サツマイモ、ジャガイモは、天候、収穫状況、輸送コストの影響を受けやすい。

segments.src: A poor growing season in one region can lift prices nationally, while a strong harvest can keep them steady.
segments.tr: ある地域の不作が全国的に価格を押し上げることもあれば、豊作によって価格が安定することもある。

segments.src: Canned and frozen versions of many items are often cheaper and last longer, which makes them a practical option for the side dishes.
segments.tr: 多くの品目の缶詰や冷凍品は一般的に安価で日持ちするため、サイドディッシュの実用的な選択肢となる。

segments.src: ## Stuffing, Rolls and Pie
segments.tr: ## スタッフィング、ロールパン、パイ

segments.src: Packaged stuffing mix, bread, flour, sugar and pie crusts depend largely on wheat, sugar and packaging costs.
segments.tr: パッケージ入りのスタッフィングミックス、パン、小麦粉、砂糖、パイ生地は、主に小麦、砂糖、包装コストに依存している。

segments.src: Pumpkin and pecan pie ingredients can swing with crop conditions.
segments.tr: カボチャやピーカンパイの材料は、作物の状況によって変動する可能性がある。

segments.src: Many shoppers save money by baking from scratch, while others find a store-bought pie cheaper once their time and extra ingredients are counted.
segments.tr: 自分でイチから作ることで節約する買い物客もいれば、自分の時間や追加の材料を計算に入れると店で買ったパイの方が安いと感じる買い物客もいる。

segments.src: ## How to Read the Annual Dinner-Cost Surveys
segments.tr: ## 年次ディナー費用調査の読み方

segments.src: Several organizations publish a yearly estimate of the cost of a Thanksgiving dinner.
segments.tr: いくつかの組織が、感謝祭のディナーの費用に関する年次見積もりを発表している。

segments.src: The best known is the American Farm Bureau Federation's survey, which prices a classic menu for a set number of guests, typically ten, using reports from volunteer shoppers across the country.
segments.tr: 最もよく知られているのはアメリカン・ファーム・ビュース・フェデレーション（米国農場主連盟）の調査であり、全国のボランティア買い物客からの報告を用いて、通常10人という設定されたゲスト数に対する古典的なメニューの価格を算出している。

segments.src: Some retailers and consumer groups publish their own versions.
segments.tr: 一部の小売業者や消費者グループは独自のバージョンを発表している。

segments.src: A few points help put these numbers in context:
segments.tr: これらの数値を文脈に照らし合わせて理解するのに役立ついくつかのポイントがある：

segments.src: 1. **Check the menu.** Surveys price a specific list of items. If your table has more dishes, different dishes or a larger crowd, your total will differ.
segments.tr: 1. **メニューを確認する。** 調査は特定の品目のリストに基づいて価格を設定している。あなたの食卓により多くの料理、異なる料理、またはより多くの人がいる場合、合計金額は異なる。

segments.src: 2. **Look at the method.** Some surveys use regular shelf prices, while others include promotions. Results can differ by several dollars for that reason alone.
segments.tr: 2. **方法を見る。** 通常の店頭価格を使用する調査もあれば、プロモーションを含める調査もある。その理由だけでも結果が数ドル異なることがある。

segments.src: 3. **Compare like with like.** A survey from one organization is not directly comparable to a survey from another.
segments.tr: 3. **同等のものを比較する。** ある組織の調査を別の組織の調査と直接比較することはできない。

segments.src: 4. **Remember it's an average.** Prices in a big city, a rural town and a discount grocer can differ widely.
segments.tr: 4. **平均値であることを忘れない。** 大都市、地方の町、ディスカウントスーパーの価格は大きく異なる場合がある。

segments.src: 5. **Watch the trend, not the decimal.** A small change from last year may not mean much. A larger shift, and what caused it, is more informative.
segments.tr: 5. **小数点ではなくトレンドを見る。** 昨年からの小さな変化は大した意味を持たないかもしれない。より大きな変化や、その原因となったものは、より多くの情報をもたらしてくれる。

segments.src: 6. **Note the timing.** Prices are collected weeks before the holiday, and store sales may change what you actually pay.
segments.tr: 6. **タイミングに注意する。** 価格は祝日の数週間前に収集され、店舗のセールによって実際に支払う金額が変わる可能性がある。

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Keep the Bill in Check
segments.tr: ## 費用を抑えるための実用的な方法

segments.src: - **Make a menu and a list first.** Planning cuts impulse purchases and food waste.
segments.tr: - **最初にメニューとリストを作る。** 計画を立てることで衝動買いや食品ロスが削減される。

segments.src: - **Compare unit prices.** The price per pound or per ounce shows the real value better than the sticker price.
segments.tr: - **単価を比較する。** ポンドあたりまたはオンスあたりの価格は、値札よりも実際の価値をよりよく示している。

segments.src: - **Use store promotions and loyalty programs,** but check whether a turkey deal requires a minimum spend.
segments.tr: - **店舗のプロモーションやロイヤルティプログラムを利用するが、** 七面鳥の割引に最低利用金額が必要かどうかを確認する。

segments.src: - **Consider alternatives.** A smaller bird, a turkey breast or a different main dish can lower costs for a smaller group.
segments.tr: - **代替案を検討する。** 小さな鳥、七面鳥の胸肉、または別のメインディッシュは、少人数グループの費用を抑えることができる。

segments.src: - **Buy shelf-stable items early** and watch for sales on baking staples.
segments.tr: - **日持ちする商品を早めに購入し、** ベーキングの定番商品のセールに目を光らせる。

segments.src: - **Share the load.** Asking guests to bring a side dish or dessert spreads out the expense.
segments.tr: - **負担を分かち合う。** ゲストにサイドディッシュやデザートを持ってきてもらうよう頼むことで、費用が分散される。

segments.src: - **Plan for leftovers** so less food goes to waste.
segments.tr: - **食品ロスを減らすために** 残り物の計画を立てる。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: Nobody can say exactly what your Thanksgiving table will cost until you are at the checkout.
segments.tr: レジに並ぶまで、あなたの感謝祭の食卓に正確にいくらかかるかを誰も言うことはできない。

segments.src: Still, understanding what moves the price of turkey, dairy and produce, and knowing how the annual surveys are built, can help you separate real trends from headlines.
segments.tr: それでも、七面鳥、乳製品、農産物の価格を動かす要因を理解し、年次調査がどのように構築されているかを知ることで、見出しから実際のトレンドを切り離すのに役立つ。

segments.src: A little planning and some comparison shopping will usually do more for your budget than any national average.
segments.tr: 少しの計画と比較ショッピングは、通常、どのような全国平均よりもあなたの予算のために多くのことを成し遂げてくれる。

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not financial advice.
segments.tr: *この記事は一般的な情報提供のみを目的としており、財務上のアドバイスではない。

segments.src: Prices vary by location and retailer.*
segments.tr: 価格は場所や小売業者によって異なる。*

segments.src: ## Why Thanksgiving Prices Get So Much Attention

segments.src: Thanksgiving is one of the few meals in the United States built around a nearly standard menu.
segments.tr: Thanksgiving ist eine der wenigen Mahlzeiten in den Vereinigten Staaten, die auf einem nahezu standardisierten Menü basieren.

segments.src: That makes it a convenient yardstick.
segments.tr: Das macht es zu einem praktischen Maßstab.

segments.src: Because most households buy a similar set of items, changes in the total are easy to compare from one year to the next.
segments.tr: Da die meisten Haushalte eine ähnliche Zusammenstellung von Artikeln kaufen, lassen sich Änderungen in der Gesamtsumme von einem Jahr zum nächsten leicht vergleichen.

segments.src: The meal also stands in for broader grocery inflation, so a rise or fall in the "dinner bill" often shapes conversations about everyday food costs.

segments.tr: - **Herdenbestand.** Erzeuger entscheiden Monate im Voraus, wie viele Vögel aufgezogen werden sollen. Ausbrüche der Vogelgrippe können die Bestände verringern und das Angebot verknappen, was die Truthahnpreise in den vergangenen Jahren in die Höhe getrieben hat.

segments.src: - **Timing.** Frozen turkeys are often cheapest in the weeks right before the holiday, while fresh birds usually cost more per pound.
